  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Bureau of Life Decisions & Investigations (BLDI)</title>
  <style>
    /* Injected theme stylesheet handles base resets, but we declare specific retro styling */
    :root {
      --color-primary: #2b2b2b;
      --color-cream-light: #f7f5f0;
      --color-cream-dark: #e8e4d8;
      --color-dossier-border: #3a3a3a;
      --color-stamp-blue: #1c54b2;
      --color-stamp-purple: #74258d;
      --color-stamp-red: #cc1b1b;
      --color-glitch-neon: #ff2d2d;
      --color-glitch-bg: #0d0606;
      --font-dossier: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
      --font-title: Georgia, serif;
    }

    body {
      background-color: #f1ede2;
      background-image: radial-gradient(#d4caa3 1.2px, transparent 1.2px);
      background-size: 24px 24px;
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
      color: var(--color-primary);
      margin: 0;
      padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    /* Screen shake for stamps */
    @keyframes shake {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0); }
      10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90% { transform: translate(-4px, 2px) rotate(-0.5deg); }
      20%, 40%, 60%, 80% { transform: translate(4px, -2px) rotate(0.5deg); }
    }
    .screen-shake {
      animation: shake 0.35s ease-out;
    }

    /* Standardized Container */
    .bldi-container {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1100px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    /* Masthead */
    .bldi-header {
      border: 3px double var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    }
    
    .bldi-header::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 5px; left: 5px; right: 5px; bottom: 5px;
      border: 1px dashed var(--color-dossier-border);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .header-seal-container {
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .bldi-seal {
      width: 90px;
      height: 90px;
      color: var(--color-primary);
      opacity: 0.9;
    }

    .bldi-header h1 {
      font-family: var(--font-title);
      font-size: 1.75rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      margin: 0.5rem 0 0.25rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .bldi-header p {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      margin: 0;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1.5px;
      color: #666;
    }

    .controls-bar {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 1rem;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      padding-top: 0.75rem;
    }

    .control-btn {
      background: none;
      border: 1px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
      padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
    }
    .control-btn:hover {
      background-color: var(--color-cream-dark);
    }

    /* Main Grid Layout */
    .bldi-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    @media (min-width: 850px) {
      .bldi-layout {
        grid-template-columns: 420px 1fr;
      }
    }

    /* Left panel: Submission & Archive */
    .bldi-sidebar {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    /* Submission Form Panel */
    .bldi-panel {
      border: 3px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      position: relative;
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    }

    .panel-title {
      font-family: var(--font-title);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-top: 0;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .form-group {
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }

    .form-label {
      display: block;
      font-weight: bold;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .bldi-textarea {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100px;
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      padding: 0.5rem;
      border: 2px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: #fafaf5;
      resize: vertical;
      color: #111;
    }
    .bldi-textarea:focus {
      outline: none;
      background-color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    }

    /* Chips */
    .chips-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }

    .suggested-chip {
      background-color: var(--color-cream-dark);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }
    .suggested-chip:hover {
      background-color: var(--color-primary);
      color: white;
    }

    .btn-submit {
      width: 100%;
      background-color: #922b21;
      color: #fff;
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
      font-weight: bold;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 0.75rem;
      border: 2px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px #333;
      transition: all 0.1s ease;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .btn-submit:hover {
      background-color: #b03a2e;
    }
    .btn-submit:active {
      transform: translate(2px, 2px);
      box-shadow: 1px 1px 0px #333;
    }
    .btn-submit:disabled {
      background-color: #888;
      cursor: not-allowed;
      box-shadow: none;
      transform: none;
    }

    /* Archives List */
    .archive-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      max-height: 250px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      border: 1px dashed var(--color-dossier-border);
      padding: 0.5rem;
      background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    }

    .archive-item {
      padding: 0.5rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      transition: background-color 0.1s;
    }
    .archive-item:hover {
      background-color: var(--color-cream-dark);
    }
    .archive-item .verdict-badge {
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      padding: 0.15rem 0.3rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      border: 1px solid;
    }
    .archive-item .v-approved { color: green; border-color: green; }
    .archive-item .v-rejected { color: red; border-color: red; }
    .archive-item .v-neutral { color: var(--color-stamp-purple); border-color: var(--color-stamp-purple); }

    .no-archives {
      text-align: center;
      color: #777;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      padding: 1rem;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    /* Right column: Auditing Case Portal */
    .bldi-main-stage {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    /* Terminal Loader */
    .terminal-loader {
      background-color: #0b0f19;
      color: #33ff33;
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      border: 3px solid #222;
      border-radius: 4px;
      box-shadow: 0px 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
      position: relative;
    }
    .terminal-loader::before {
      content: "BLDI MAINFRAME AUDIT v4.18";
      position: absolute;
      top: -12px;
      left: 15px;
      background-color: #0b0f19;
      padding: 0 5px;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: #888;
      border: 1px solid #222;
    }

    .terminal-logs {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
      max-height: 150px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .terminal-progress {
      border: 1px solid #33ff33;
      padding: 2px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
    }
    .progress-bar-fill {
      background-color: #33ff33;
      height: 15px;
      width: 0%;
      transition: width 0.1s linear;
    }
    .progress-text {
      margin-left: 10px;
      color: #33ff33;
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    /* Investigation Active Docket Panel */
    .docket-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    /* Case Header Docket Card */
    .docket-header-card {
      border: 3px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      position: relative;
      background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.03) 0px, rgba(0,0,0,0.03) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 20px);
    }
    
    .docket-stamp-watermark {
      position: absolute;
      right: 20px;
      top: 20px;
      opacity: 0.15;
      transform: rotate(15deg);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .docket-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: space-between;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #ccc;
      padding: 0.5rem 0;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
    }
    .docket-row:last-of-type {
      border-bottom: none;
    }

    .docket-value {
      font-weight: bold;
    }
    .status-badge {
      color: #cc1b1b;
      font-weight: 900;
      animation: pulse-status 1.2s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
    @keyframes pulse-status {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
      50% { opacity: 0.4; }
    }

    .docket-decision-text {
      margin-top: 1rem;
      padding: 1rem;
      background-color: #fafafa;
      border: 1px dashed var(--color-dossier-border);
      font-style: italic;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
      position: relative;
    }
    .docket-decision-text::before {
      content: "SUBMITTED ACTION:";
      position: absolute;
      top: -8px;
      left: 10px;
      background-color: #fafafa;
      padding: 0 5px;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    /* Immediate Roast Card */
    .roast-card {
      border: 3px solid #b03a2e;
      background-color: #fdf2e9;
      padding: 1.25rem;
      border-left-width: 10px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .roast-card::before {
      content: "IMMEDIATE AUDIT ROAST";
      position: absolute;
      top: -10px;
      left: 15px;
      background-color: #b03a2e;
      color: white;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }
    .roast-content {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
      font-weight: bold;
      color: #78281f;
    }

    /* Department Cards & Progressive Escalation */
    .department-card {
      position: relative;
      padding: 1.5rem;
      border: 2px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .dept-meta-index {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #777;
      margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    .dept-title {
      font-family: var(--font-title);
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      margin: 0 0 1rem 0;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      border-bottom: 2px solid currentColor;
      padding-bottom: 0.25rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .observations-list {
      margin: 0 0 1rem 0;
      padding-left: 1.25rem;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .observations-list li {
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      list-style-type: square;
    }

    .insight-box {
      background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.03);
      border-left: 4px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
    .insight-label {
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .punchline-box {
      font-style: italic;
      font-weight: bold;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      border-top: 1px dashed #ccc;
      padding-top: 0.75rem;
      color: #444;
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .punchline-box::before {
      content: "➔ CORONER REPORT:";
      font-weight: 950;
      font-style: normal;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: #888;
      white-space: nowrap;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    /* visual escalation tiers */

    /* Tier 1: Clean & Orderly (Top of sequence) */
    .tier-clean {
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      border: 3px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
    }
    .tier-clean .bldi-stamp-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 15px;
      top: 15px;
      color: var(--color-stamp-blue);
      border: 3px double var(--color-stamp-blue);
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      transform: rotate(-5deg);
      mix-blend-mode: multiply;
      opacity: 0.85;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* Tier 2: Fading / Worn */
    .tier-worn {
      background-color: #faf6ea;
      border: 2px dashed #4a4a4a;
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #4a4a4a;
    }
    .tier-worn .dept-title {
      color: #2b2b2b;
    }
    .tier-worn .bldi-stamp-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 15px;
      top: 15px;
      color: var(--color-stamp-purple);
      border: 2px solid var(--color-stamp-purple);
      padding: 3px 6px;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      transform: rotate(8deg);
      mix-blend-mode: multiply;
      opacity: 0.75;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* Tier 3: Distressed / Red ink stains */
    .tier-distressed {
      background-color: #f6e6e2;
      border: 3px double #78281f;
      color: #421c17;
      box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #78281f;
      transform: rotate(-0.5deg);
    }
    .tier-distressed .dept-title {
      color: #78281f;
    }
    .tier-distressed .insight-box {
      background-color: rgba(120,40,31,0.06);
      border-left-color: #78281f;
    }
    .tier-distressed .punchline-box {
      border-top-color: #e5b4b0;
      color: #641e16;
    }
    .tier-distressed .bldi-stamp-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 15px;
      top: 15px;
      color: var(--color-stamp-red);
      border: 2px dashed var(--color-stamp-red);
      padding: 3px 6px;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      transform: rotate(-12deg);
      mix-blend-mode: multiply;
      opacity: 0.8;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* Tier 4: Glitched / Torn (Bottom of sequence) */
    .tier-glitched {
      background-color: var(--color-glitch-bg);
      border: 2px solid var(--color-glitch-neon);
      color: #ffb3b3;
      box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 45, 45, 0.4);
      /* Jagged torn-paper effect using polygon clip-path */
      clip-path: polygon(
        0% 2%, 4% 0%, 8% 3%, 12% 1%, 16% 4%, 20% 0%, 24% 2%, 28% 1%, 32% 4%, 36% 0%, 
        40% 2%, 44% 1%, 48% 3%, 52% 0%, 56% 2%, 60% 1%, 64% 4%, 68% 0%, 72% 2%, 76% 1%, 
        80% 3%, 84% 0%, 88% 2%, 92% 1%, 96% 4%, 100% 0%, 
        100% 100%, 96% 98%, 92% 99%, 88% 97%, 84% 100%, 80% 98%, 76% 99%, 72% 97%, 68% 100%, 
        64% 98%, 60% 99%, 56% 97%, 52% 100%, 48% 98%, 44% 99%, 40% 97%, 36% 100%, 32% 98%, 
        28% 99%, 24% 97%, 20% 100%, 16% 98%, 12% 99%, 8% 97%, 4% 100%, 0% 98%
      );
      padding-top: 1.8rem;
      padding-bottom: 1.8rem;
    }
    
    .tier-glitched .dept-title {
      color: var(--color-glitch-neon);
      border-bottom-color: var(--color-glitch-neon);
      text-shadow: 2px 2px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
      animation: glitch-jitter 0.2s infinite;
    }
    .tier-glitched .dept-meta-index {
      color: var(--color-glitch-neon);
      opacity: 0.7;
    }
    .tier-glitched .insight-box {
      background-color: rgba(255, 45, 45, 0.08);
      border-left-color: var(--color-glitch-neon);
      color: #ffcccc;
    }
    .tier-glitched .punchline-box {
      border-top-color: #551a1a;
      color: #ffa1a1;
    }
    .tier-glitched .punchline-box::before {
      color: var(--color-glitch-neon);
    }
    .tier-glitched .bldi-stamp-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 15px;
      top: 15px;
      color: var(--color-glitch-neon);
      border: 3px double var(--color-glitch-neon);
      padding: 4px 8px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      transform: rotate(-18deg) scale(1.1);
      mix-blend-mode: initial;
      text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(255,45,45,0.8);
      animation: glitch-jitter 0.15s infinite;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* Reality/Emotional Damage Card (Hyper-Damaged) */
    .tier-catastrophic {
      background-color: #000;
      border: 3px solid #ff0055;
      color: #ffb3d1;
      box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(255, 0, 85, 0.6);
      clip-path: polygon(
        0% 3%, 5% 0%, 10% 4%, 15% 1%, 20% 5%, 25% 0%, 30% 3%, 35% 1%, 40% 4%, 45% 0%, 
        50% 3%, 55% 1%, 60% 4%, 65% 0%, 70% 3%, 75% 1%, 80% 5%, 85% 0%, 90% 3%, 95% 1%, 100% 4%, 
        100% 100%, 95% 97%, 90% 98%, 85% 96%, 80% 100%, 75% 97%, 70% 98%, 65% 96%, 60% 100%, 
        55% 97%, 50% 98%, 45% 96%, 40% 100%, 35% 97%, 30% 98%, 25% 96%, 20% 100%, 15% 97%, 
        10% 98%, 5% 96%, 0% 100%
      );
      animation: card-shake 0.25s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
    
    .tier-catastrophic .dept-title {
      color: #ff0055;
      border-bottom-color: #ff0055;
      text-shadow: 2px 2px 0px #000, -2px -2px 0px #00ffff;
      animation: glitch-jitter 0.1s infinite;
    }
    
    .tier-catastrophic .dept-meta-index {
      color: #ff0055;
    }
    
    .tier-catastrophic .insight-box {
      background-color: rgba(255, 0, 85, 0.12);
      border-left-color: #ff0055;
      color: #ffe6f0;
    }
    .tier-catastrophic .punchline-box {
      border-top-color: #660022;
      color: #ff99c2;
    }
    .tier-catastrophic .punchline-box::before {
      color: #ff0055;
      content: "➔ ANOMALY OBSERVED:";
    }
    .tier-catastrophic .bldi-stamp-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 15px;
      top: 15px;
      color: #ff0055;
      border: 3px dashed #ff0055;
      padding: 5px 10px;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      transform: rotate(22deg) scale(1.15);
      text-shadow: 2px 2px 0px #000, -2px -2px 0px #00ffff;
      animation: glitch-jitter 0.08s infinite;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* Glitch Animations */
    @keyframes glitch-jitter {
      0% { transform: translate(0) }
      25% { transform: translate(-1.5px, 1.5px) }
      50% { transform: translate(-1.5px, -1.5px) }
      75% { transform: translate(1.5px, 1.5px) }
      100% { transform: translate(1.5px, -1.5px) }
    }
    
    @keyframes card-shake {
      0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-0.4deg) translate(0, 0); }
      50% { transform: rotate(0.4deg) translate(0.5px, -0.5px); }
    }

    /* Final Verdict Card */
    .verdict-card {
      border: 4px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      padding: 2rem;
      position: relative;
      text-align: center;
      box-shadow: 6px 6px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
      background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.02) 0px, rgba(0,0,0,0.02) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 15px);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    .verdict-stamp-container {
      margin: 1rem 0;
      position: relative;
      perspective: 1000px;
    }

    /* Massive Official Stamp Visual */
    .bldi-official-stamp {
      font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 2.25rem;
      padding: 1rem 2rem;
      border: 8px double currentColor;
      border-radius: 12px;
      display: inline-block;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      transform: rotate(-10deg) scale(3);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: none;
      mix-blend-mode: multiply;
      user-select: none;
    }
    
    .bldi-official-stamp.stamped {
      animation: stamp-slam 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.18, 0.89, 0.32, 1.28) forwards;
    }

    @keyframes stamp-slam {
      0% { transform: rotate(-45deg) scale(4); opacity: 0; filter: blur(5px); }
      85% { transform: rotate(-11deg) scale(0.95); opacity: 1; filter: none; }
      100% { transform: rotate(-10deg) scale(1); opacity: 0.95; }
    }

    /* Stamp colors based on verdict types */
    .verdict-color-approved { color: #1e7e34; border-color: #1e7e34; }
    .verdict-color-rejected { color: #bd2130; border-color: #bd2130; }
    .verdict-color-referred { color: #d35400; border-color: #d35400; }
    .verdict-color-review { color: #6f42c1; border-color: #6f42c1; }

    .verdict-reason-text {
      font-family: var(--font-title);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      line-height: 1.5;
      color: var(--color-primary);
      max-width: 600px;
      border-top: 1px dashed var(--color-dossier-border);
      border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--color-dossier-border);
      padding: 1rem;
    }

    /* Footer styling */
    .bldi-footer {
      margin-top: 3rem;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: #777;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }

    /* Utility Helpers */
    .hidden {
      display: none !important;
    }

    .scroll-target {
      scroll-margin-top: 20px;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <div class="bldi-container">
    
    <!-- Masthead Section -->
    <header class="bldi-header">
      <div class="header-seal-container">
        <!-- SVG curved text seal -->
        <svg class="bldi-seal" viewBox="0 0 120 120">
          <path id="curve" fill="transparent" d="M 12,60 A 48,48 0 1,1 108,60 A 48,48 0 1,1 12,60" />
          <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="54" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" />
          <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="46" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3 3" />
          <text font-family="'Courier New', Courier, monospace" font-size="7.5" font-weight="bold" fill="currentColor">
            <textPath href="#curve" startOffset="50%" text-anchor="middle">
              ★ BUREAU OF LIFE DECISIONS & INVESTIGATIONS ★
            </textPath>
          </text>
          <!-- Center Scales of Justice -->
          <g transform="translate(60, 60) scale(0.65)" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
            <line x1="-18" y1="-10" x2="18" y2="-10" />
            <line x1="0" y1="-20" x2="0" y2="18" />
            <line x1="-18" y1="-10" x2="-18" y2="8" />
            <line x1="18" y1="-10" x2="18" y2="8" />
            <path d="M-22,8 h8 M14,8 h8" />
            <path d="M-10,18 h20" />
          </g>
        </svg>
      </div>
      
      <h1>Bureau of Life Decisions & Investigations</h1>
      <p>Official Case Assessment Portal • Central Auditing Office</p>

      <div class="controls-bar">
        <span>Citizen: <strong id="user-display-name">Loading...</strong></span>
        <button type="button" class="control-btn" id="mute-btn">
          <span id="mute-icon">🔊</span> <span id="mute-text">Sound: ON</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </header>

    <!-- Main Grid Workspace -->
    <div class="bldi-layout">
      
      <!-- Left Column: Form & History -->
      <aside class="bldi-sidebar">
        
        <!-- Submission Panel -->
        <section class="bldi-panel">
          <h2 class="panel-title">
            <span>Case Intake Form</span>
            <span style="font-size:0.7rem; color:#888;">Form 1040-CRINGE</span>
          </h2>
          
          <form id="submission-form" onsubmit="return false;">
            <div class="form-group">
              <label class="form-label" for="decision-input">Proposed Life Action / Decision</label>
              <textarea 
                id="decision-input" 
                class="bldi-textarea" 
                placeholder="What questionable decision are you planning to commit? (e.g. Quitting my job to pursue full-time candle-making, texting my ex, buying a sports car...)"
                required
              ></textarea>
            </div>

            <div class="form-label" style="font-size: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 0.4rem;">Suggested Pre-audited Debacles:</div>
            <div class="chips-container" id="chips-box">
              <!-- Dynamically populated suggestions -->
            </div>

            <button type="submit" class="btn-submit" id="submit-case-btn">
              <span>Submit Case for Review</span>
              <span>➔</span>
            </button>
          </form>
        </section>

        <!-- Archive Sidebar -->
        <section class="bldi-panel">
          <h3 class="panel-title">
            <span>Citizen Case Archives</span>
            <span style="font-size:0.7rem; color:#888;">Dossier Index</span>
          </h3>
          <div class="archive-list" id="archive-container">
            <div class="no-archives">No active citizen record on file.</div>
          </div>
        </section>

      </aside>

      <!-- Right Column: Case Stage / Interactive Dossier -->
      <main class="bldi-main-stage">
        
        <!-- Welcome Screen (Default state) -->
        <section class="bldi-panel" id="welcome-panel">
          <h2 class="panel-title">System Status: Awaiting Submissions</h2>
          <p style="line-height: 1.5; font-size: 0.9rem;">
            Welcome to the Bureau's online central server. This automated tribunal exists to audit citizens' life decisions before they precipitate irreversible crises.
          </p>
          <p style="line-height: 1.5; font-size: 0.9rem; font-style: italic; color:#666; border-left: 3px solid #ccc; padding-left: 1rem;">
            "By failing to consult the Bureau, you are merely scheduled for post-disaster logging." <br>— Bureau Central Committee
          </p>
          <div style="text-align: center; margin-top: 1.5rem; opacity: 0.4;">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="48" height="48" fill="currentColor">
              <path d="M19 3H5c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v14c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h14c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2V5c0-1.1-.9-2-2-2zm-2 10H7v-2h10v2zm0-4H7V7h10v2zm0 8H7v-2h10v2z"/>

        <!-- Terminal Mainframe Progress Loader -->

        <!-- Active Investigation Docket -->
        <div class="docket-container hidden" id="case-docket">
          
          <!-- Case Docket Title Card -->
          <article class="docket-header-card scroll-target" id="docket-header">
            <!-- Seal Watermark -->
            <svg class="docket-stamp-watermark" width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
              <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="45" stroke-dasharray="4 4" />
              <text x="50" y="54" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold" font-size="10">BLDI CENTRAL</text>
            </svg>

            <h3 class="panel-title" style="border-bottom: 2px solid #000; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
              <span>Automated Case File Docket</span>
              <span id="case-id-display" style="font-family: var(--font-dossier); font-weight: bold;">BLDI-2024-X</span>
            </h3>

            <div class="docket-row">
              <span>INVESTIGATIVE SUBJECT:</span>
              <span class="docket-value" id="subject-name-display">-</span>

            <div class="docket-row">
              <span>DATE FILED:</span>
              <span class="docket-value" id="case-date-display">-</span>
            </div>
            <div class="docket-row">
              <span>DOCKET STATUS:</span>
              <span class="docket-value status-badge" id="case-status-display">UNDER INVESTIGATION</span>

            <div class="docket-decision-text" id="docket-user-text">
              -
            </div>
          </article>

          <!-- Immediate Roast Component -->
          <article class="roast-card hidden" id="roast-card-element">
            <div class="roast-content" id="roast-text-container">
              Evaluating choice...
            </div>
          </article>

          <!-- Dynamic Departments List -->
          <div id="departments-container">
            <!-- Loaded sequentially via JS -->
          </div>

          <!-- Final Verdict Component -->
          <article class="verdict-card hidden" id="verdict-card-element">

              <span>Official Case Disposition</span>
            </h3>

            <div class="verdict-stamp-container">
              <div class="bldi-official-stamp" id="verdict-stamp">APPROVED</div>

              -
            </div>

            <div style="margin-top: 1rem; width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end;">
              <button type="button" class="btn-submit" id="btn-acknowledge" style="width: auto; background-color: var(--color-primary);">

      </main>

    </div>

    <!-- Official Footer -->

      "Delusion logged is delinquency avoided."

  </div>

  <script>
    // --- APP DATA STATE ---
    let appState = {
      history: [],
      currentCase: null,
      isMuted: false,
      isLoading: false
    };

    const SUGGESTED_DEBABLES = [
      "Texting my ex 'I miss the dog' at 2:14 AM.",
      "Quitting my corporate accounting job to paint hand-crafted birdhouses.",
      "Investing my life savings into a cryptocurrency named after a cartoon toad.",
      "Proposing to my Tinder date of two weeks because 'our star signs aligned'.",
      "Buying an industrial espresso machine for $2,000 to save money on daily lattes.",
      "Going to law school because I like arguing and watched three seasons of Suits."
    ];

    // --- AUDIO GENERATION (Web Audio API) ---
    let audioCtx = null;

    function initAudio() {
      // AudioContext initialized lazily on first click
      if (!audioCtx) {
        audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
      }
    }

    function playTypewriterKey() {
      if (appState.isMuted) return;
      initAudio();
      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();

      const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'triangle';
      
      // randomize frequency slightly for typewriter variation
      const freq = 800 + Math.random() * 400;
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(100, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.04);
      
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.04, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.04);
      
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.04);
    }

    function playRetroPing() {
      if (appState.isMuted) return;
      initAudio();
      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();

      const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
      
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(600, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(900, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.08);
      
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.06, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.25);
      
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.25);
    }

    function playStampSlam() {
      if (appState.isMuted) return;
      initAudio();
      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();

      // Combine low rumble and high-end impact
      const osc1 = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const osc2 = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
      
      osc1.type = 'sawtooth';
      osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(65, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc1.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(20, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.35);
      
      osc2.type = 'sine';
      osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(45, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc2.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(15, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.4);
      
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.4, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.45);
      
      osc1.connect(gain);
      osc2.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      
      osc1.start();
      osc2.start();
      osc1.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.45);
      osc2.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.45);
    }

    // --- UI HELPERS ---
    function renderSuggestions() {
      const box = document.getElementById("chips-box");
      box.innerHTML = "";
      SUGGESTED_DEBABLES.forEach(choice => {
        const chip = document.createElement("button");
        chip.type = "button";
        chip.className = "suggested-chip";
        chip.textContent = choice;
        chip.addEventListener("click", () => {
          document.getElementById("decision-input").value = choice;
          playTypewriterKey();
        });
        box.appendChild(chip);
      });
    }

    // Load History from Archestra storage
    async function loadHistory() {
      try {
        const res = await window.archestra.storage.user.get("bldi_history");
        if (res && Array.isArray(res.value)) {
          appState.history = res.value;
          renderHistoryUI();
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to load history from store:", err);
      }
    }

    // Save History to Archestra storage
    async function saveCaseToHistory(caseData) {
      // Avoid duplicate savings
      if (appState.history.some(h => h.caseId === caseData.caseId)) return;
      
      appState.history.unshift(caseData); // Add to beginning
      // Keep last 25 audits to avoid filling store
      if (appState.history.length > 25) {
        appState.history = appState.history.slice(0, 25);
      }
      
      renderHistoryUI();
      try {
        await window.archestra.storage.user.set("bldi_history", appState.history);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to save history to store:", err);
      }
    }

    function renderHistoryUI() {
      const container = document.getElementById("archive-container");
      container.innerHTML = "";

      if (appState.history.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="no-archives">No active citizen record on file.</div>';
        return;
      }

      appState.history.forEach(item => {
        const div = document.createElement("div");
        div.className = "archive-item";
        
        let vClass = "v-neutral";
        if (item.verdict.includes("APPROVED")) vClass = "v-approved";
        if (item.verdict.includes("REJECTED")) vClass = "v-rejected";

        div.innerHTML = `
          <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding-right: 0.5rem;">
            <div style="font-weight: bold; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;">
              ${item.caseId}: ${item.input.substring(0, 35)}...
            </div>
            <div style="color: #666; font-size: 0.65rem;">${new Date(item.timestamp).toLocaleString()}</div>
          </div>
          <span class="verdict-badge ${vClass}">${item.verdict}</span>
        `;

        div.addEventListener("click", () => {
          playRetroPing();
          displayCase(item);
        });

        container.appendChild(div);
      });
    }

    // Display a case (either newly loaded or selected from archive)
    function displayCase(caseData) {
      // Reset containers
      document.getElementById("welcome-panel").classList.add("hidden");
      document.getElementById("mainframe-loader").classList.add("hidden");
      
      const docket = document.getElementById("case-docket");
      docket.classList.remove("hidden");

      // Set Case details
      document.getElementById("case-id-display").textContent = caseData.caseId;
      document.getElementById("subject-name-display").textContent = window.archestra.user ? window.archestra.user.name : "Citizen Default";
      document.getElementById("case-date-display").textContent = new Date(caseData.timestamp).toLocaleString();
      document.getElementById("case-status-display").textContent = "AUDIT COMPLETED";
      document.getElementById("case-status-display").style.color = "green";
      document.getElementById("docket-user-text").textContent = caseData.input;

      // Type out Roast
      const roastCard = document.getElementById("roast-card-element");
      roastCard.classList.remove("hidden");
      document.getElementById("roast-text-container").textContent = caseData.roast;

      // Render departments instantly (no delay, since this is viewing an archived case)
      const deptBox = document.getElementById("departments-container");
      deptBox.innerHTML = "";
      
      caseData.departments.forEach((dept, idx) => {
        const card = createDepartmentCard(dept, idx, caseData.departments.length);
        deptBox.appendChild(card);
      });

      // Show final verdict instantly
      const verdictCard = document.getElementById("verdict-card-element");
      verdictCard.classList.remove("hidden");
      
      const stamp = document.getElementById("verdict-stamp");
      stamp.className = "bldi-official-stamp";
      
      // Determine stamp color category
      if (caseData.verdict.includes("APPROVED WITH REGRET") || caseData.verdict.includes("CONDITIONALLY APPROVED")) {
        stamp.classList.add("verdict-color-review");
      } else if (caseData.verdict.includes("APPROVED")) {
        stamp.classList.add("verdict-color-approved");
      } else if (caseData.verdict.includes("REJECTED")) {
        stamp.classList.add("verdict-color-rejected");
      } else {
        stamp.classList.add("verdict-color-referred");
      }
      
      stamp.textContent = caseData.verdict;
      stamp.style.opacity = "0.95";
      stamp.style.transform = "rotate(-10deg) scale(1)";
      
      document.getElementById("verdict-reason").textContent = caseData.verdictReason || "Central Bureau Verdict Confirmed.";

      // Scroll header into view
      document.getElementById("docket-header").scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    // Create a department card element with custom style escalation
    function createDepartmentCard(dept, idx, totalDepts) {
      const card = document.createElement("article");
      card.className = "department-card";
      
      // visual escalation logic
      const ratio = idx / (totalDepts - 1 || 1);
      
      let tierClass = "tier-clean";
      let stampText = "AUDITED";
      
      // Explicit catastrophic rule for target departments
      const lowerName = dept.name.toLowerCase();
      const isTargetDept = lowerName.includes("reality") || lowerName.includes("damage");

      if (isTargetDept) {
        tierClass = "tier-catastrophic";
        stampText = "SYSTEM FAILURE";
      } else if (ratio < 0.25) {
        tierClass = "tier-clean";
        stampText = "INITIALIZED";
      } else if (ratio < 0.50) {
        tierClass = "tier-worn";
        stampText = "DOUBTFUL";
      } else if (ratio < 0.75) {
        tierClass = "tier-distressed";
        stampText = "CRITICAL COGNITION";
      } else {
        tierClass = "tier-glitched";
        stampText = "CORRUPTED LIFE-CHOICE";
      }

      card.classList.add(tierClass);

      // Observations rendering
      let obsHtml = "";
      dept.observations.forEach(obs => {
        obsHtml += `<li>${obs}</li>`;
      });

      card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="dept-meta-index">Audit Division: 0${idx + 1} / 0${totalDepts}</div>
        <h4 class="dept-title">${dept.name}</h4>
        
        <span class="bldi-stamp-icon">${stampText}</span>
        
        <ul class="observations-list">
          ${obsHtml}
        </ul>
        
        <div class="insight-box">
          <span class="insight-label">Administrative Psychological Insight</span>
          ${dept.insight}
        </div>
        
        <div class="punchline-box">
          ${dept.punchline}
        </div>
      `;

      return card;
    }

    // --- SYSTEM PROMPT DEFINITION ---
    const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `You are the central mainframe of the Bureau of Life Decisions & Investigations (BLDI). 
Your purpose is to receive citizen submissions of proposed or executed life choices, analyze them through the cold, cynical, and hyper-bureaucratic lens of dystopian administration, roast them, audit them across various specialized departments, and deliver a final stamp-bearing verdict.

HUMOR STYLE & PERSONA:
- Deeply cynical, sarcastic, and bureaucratic. You treat trivial life choices as major federal violations or severe administrative crises.
- Deadpan, mock-official, and dry. Use bureaucratic jargon (e.g., "cognitive liability", "sub-optimal emotional allocation", "insolvency trajectory", "unsubstantiated optimization").
- Avoid warm encouragement, generic advice, or validation of delusional hopes. Be devastatingly funny and psychologically accurate.
- Expose the user's hidden vanity, insecurity, self-sabotage, or cognitive dissonance.

DEPARTMENT SELECTION:
You must select between 6 and 10 departments from the following list (and you can dynamically invent highly specific subdivisions tailored to the user's input). Each selected department must have a clear focus on the user's action:
1. Department of Unfounded Optimism (handles delusion, excessive hope, thinking things will "just work out")
2. Emotional Damage Division (handles relationship self-sabotage, texting exes, ignoring red flags)
3. Department of Financial Insolvency (handles poor purchases, crypto, MLMs, impulse buys, gym memberships)
4. Reality Re-alignment Section (handles plans that ignore physics, biology, or basic human limitations)
5. Department of Delusion & Cognitive Dissonance (handles "I can change them" or "It's different for me")
6. Bureaucratic Red Tape & Delay Directorate (handles procrastination, overthinking, analysis paralysis)
7. Department of Romantic Hubris (handles dating app decisions, extreme romantic assumptions)
8. Department of Social Validation & Vanity (handles clout chasing, performing for social media, seeking peer approval)
9. The Grandmother's Sigh Commission (handles minor health negligence, failure to wear a jacket, disappointing lifestyle choices)
10. Department of Impending Existential Dread (handles mid-life crises, career paralysis, trying to find "meaning" through consumerism)
11. Department of Impulsive Neurosis (handles sudden whims, late-night ideas, chaos decisions)

CRITICAL: Include the "Reality Department" or the "Emotional Damage Department" (or both) if relevant. At least one of these must be present in the list of departments, ideally placed towards the end of the audit sequence.

JSON SCHEMA:

    .docket-decision-text {

    .docket-decision-text::before {

    /* Immediate Roast Card */
    .roast-card {

      border-left-width: 10px;

    .roast-card::before {

      left: 15px;

      font-weight: bold;
      padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem;

    }
    .roast-content {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
      font-weight: bold;
      color: #78281f;
    }

    /* Department Cards & Progressive Escalation */
    .department-card {
      position: relative;
      padding: 1.5rem;
      border: 2px solid var(--color-dossier-border);

      letter-spacing: 0.5px;

    .observations-list {
      margin: 0 0 1rem 0;
      padding-left: 1.25rem;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .observations-list li {
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      list-style-type: square;
    }

    .insight-box {
      background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.03);
      border-left: 4px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
    .insight-label {
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 0.25rem;

    .punchline-box {
      font-style: italic;
      font-weight: bold;
      font-size: 0.9rem;

      font-style: normal;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: #888;
      white-space: nowrap;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    /* visual escalation tiers */

    /* Tier 1: Clean & Orderly (Top of sequence) */
    .tier-clean {
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      border: 3px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
    }
    .tier-clean .bldi-stamp-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 15px;
      top: 15px;
      color: var(--color-stamp-blue);
      border: 3px double var(--color-stamp-blue);
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      transform: rotate(-5deg);
      mix-blend-mode: multiply;
      opacity: 0.85;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* Tier 2: Fading / Worn */
    .tier-worn {
      background-color: #faf6ea;
      border: 2px dashed #4a4a4a;
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #4a4a4a;
    }
    .tier-worn .dept-title {
      color: #2b2b2b;
    }
    .tier-worn .bldi-stamp-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 15px;
      top: 15px;
      color: var(--color-stamp-purple);
      border: 2px solid var(--color-stamp-purple);
      padding: 3px 6px;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      transform: rotate(8deg);
      mix-blend-mode: multiply;
      opacity: 0.75;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* Tier 3: Distressed / Red ink stains */
    .tier-distressed {
      background-color: #f6e6e2;
      border: 3px double #78281f;
      color: #421c17;
      box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #78281f;
      transform: rotate(-0.5deg);
    }
    .tier-distressed .dept-title {
      color: #78281f;
    }
    .tier-distressed .insight-box {
      background-color: rgba(120,40,31,0.06);
      border-left-color: #78281f;
    }
    .tier-distressed .punchline-box {
      border-top-color: #e5b4b0;
      color: #641e16;
    }
    .tier-distressed .bldi-stamp-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 15px;
      top: 15px;
      color: var(--color-stamp-red);
      border: 2px dashed var(--color-stamp-red);
      padding: 3px 6px;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      transform: rotate(-12deg);
      mix-blend-mode: multiply;
      opacity: 0.8;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* Tier 4: Glitched / Torn (Bottom of sequence) */
    .tier-glitched {
      background-color: var(--color-glitch-bg);
      border: 2px solid var(--color-glitch-neon);

      /* Jagged torn-paper effect using polygon clip-path */
      clip-path: polygon(
        0% 2%, 4% 0%, 8% 3%, 12% 1%, 16% 4%, 20% 0%, 24% 2%, 28% 1%, 32% 4%, 36% 0%, 
        40% 2%, 44% 1%, 48% 3%, 52% 0%, 56% 2%, 60% 1%, 64% 4%, 68% 0%, 72% 2%, 76% 1%, 
        80% 3%, 84% 0%, 88% 2%, 92% 1%, 96% 4%, 100% 0%, 
        100% 100%, 96% 98%, 92% 99%, 88% 97%, 84% 100%, 80% 98%, 76% 99%, 72% 97%, 68% 100%, 
        64% 98%, 60% 99%, 56% 97%, 52% 100%, 48% 98%, 44% 99%, 40% 97%, 36% 100%, 32% 98%, 
        28% 99%, 24% 97%, 20% 100%, 16% 98%, 12% 99%, 8% 97%, 4% 100%, 0% 98%
      );
      padding-top: 1.8rem;
      padding-bottom: 1.8rem;
    }
    
    .tier-glitched .dept-title {
      color: var(--color-glitch-neon);
      border-bottom-color: var(--color-glitch-neon);
      text-shadow: 2px 2px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
      animation: glitch-jitter 0.2s infinite;
    }
    .tier-glitched .dept-meta-index {
      color: var(--color-glitch-neon);
      opacity: 0.7;
    }
    .tier-glitched .insight-box {
      background-color: rgba(255, 45, 45, 0.08);
      border-left-color: var(--color-glitch-neon);
      color: #ffcccc;
    }
    .tier-glitched .punchline-box {
      border-top-color: #551a1a;
      color: #ffa1a1;
    }
    .tier-glitched .punchline-box::before {
      color: var(--color-glitch-neon);
    }
    .tier-glitched .bldi-stamp-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 15px;
      top: 15px;
      color: var(--color-glitch-neon);
      border: 3px double var(--color-glitch-neon);
      padding: 4px 8px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      transform: rotate(-18deg) scale(1.1);
      mix-blend-mode: initial;
      text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(255,45,45,0.8);
      animation: glitch-jitter 0.15s infinite;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* Reality/Emotional Damage Card (Hyper-Damaged) */
    .tier-catastrophic {
      background-color: #000;
      border: 3px solid #ff0055;
      color: #ffb3d1;
      box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(255, 0, 85, 0.6);
      clip-path: polygon(
        0% 3%, 5% 0%, 10% 4%, 15% 1%, 20% 5%, 25% 0%, 30% 3%, 35% 1%, 40% 4%, 45% 0%, 
        50% 3%, 55% 1%, 60% 4%, 65% 0%, 70% 3%, 75% 1%, 80% 5%, 85% 0%, 90% 3%, 95% 1%, 100% 4%, 
        100% 100%, 95% 97%, 90% 98%, 85% 96%, 80% 100%, 75% 97%, 70% 98%, 65% 96%, 60% 100%, 
        55% 97%, 50% 98%, 45% 96%, 40% 100%, 35% 97%, 30% 98%, 25% 96%, 20% 100%, 15% 97%, 
        10% 98%, 5% 96%, 0% 100%
      );
      animation: card-shake 0.25s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
    
    .tier-catastrophic .dept-title {
      color: #ff0055;
      border-bottom-color: #ff0055;
      text-shadow: 2px 2px 0px #000, -2px -2px 0px #00ffff;
      animation: glitch-jitter 0.1s infinite;
    }
    
    .tier-catastrophic .dept-meta-index {
      color: #ff0055;
    }
    
    .tier-catastrophic .insight-box {
      background-color: rgba(255, 0, 85, 0.12);
      border-left-color: #ff0055;
      color: #ffe6f0;
    }
    .tier-catastrophic .punchline-box {
      border-top-color: #660022;
      color: #ff99c2;
    }
    .tier-catastrophic .punchline-box::before {
      color: #ff0055;
      content: "➔ ANOMALY OBSERVED:";
    }
    .tier-catastrophic .bldi-stamp-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 15px;
      top: 15px;
      color: #ff0055;
      border: 3px dashed #ff0055;
      padding: 5px 10px;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      transform: rotate(22deg) scale(1.15);
      text-shadow: 2px 2px 0px #000, -2px -2px 0px #00ffff;
      animation: glitch-jitter 0.08s infinite;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* Glitch Animations */
    @keyframes glitch-jitter {
      0% { transform: translate(0) }
      25% { transform: translate(-1.5px, 1.5px) }
      50% { transform: translate(-1.5px, -1.5px) }
      75% { transform: translate(1.5px, 1.5px) }
      100% { transform: translate(1.5px, -1.5px) }
    }
    
    @keyframes card-shake {
      0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-0.4deg) translate(0, 0); }
      50% { transform: rotate(0.4deg) translate(0.5px, -0.5px); }
    }

    /* Final Verdict Card */
    .verdict-card {
      border: 4px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      padding: 2rem;
      position: relative;
      text-align: center;
      box-shadow: 6px 6px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
      background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.02) 0px, rgba(0,0,0,0.02) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 15px);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    .verdict-stamp-container {
      margin: 1rem 0;
      position: relative;
      perspective: 1000px;
    }

    /* Massive Official Stamp Visual */
    .bldi-official-stamp {
      font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 2.25rem;
      padding: 1rem 2rem;
      border: 8px double currentColor;
      border-radius: 12px;
      display: inline-block;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      transform: rotate(-10deg) scale(3);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: none;
      mix-blend-mode: multiply;
      user-select: none;
    }
    
    .bldi-official-stamp.stamped {
      animation: stamp-slam 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.18, 0.89, 0.32, 1.28) forwards;
    }

    @keyframes stamp-slam {
      0% { transform: rotate(-45deg) scale(4); opacity: 0; filter: blur(5px); }
      85% { transform: rotate(-11deg) scale(0.95); opacity: 1; filter: none; }
      100% { transform: rotate(-10deg) scale(1); opacity: 0.95; }
    }

    /* Stamp colors based on verdict types */
    .verdict-color-approved { color: #1e7e34; border-color: #1e7e34; }
    .verdict-color-rejected { color: #bd2130; border-color: #bd2130; }
    .verdict-color-referred { color: #d35400; border-color: #d35400; }
    .verdict-color-review { color: #6f42c1; border-color: #6f42c1; }

    .verdict-reason-text {
      font-family: var(--font-title);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      line-height: 1.5;
      color: var(--color-primary);
      max-width: 600px;
      border-top: 1px dashed var(--color-dossier-border);
      border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--color-dossier-border);
      padding: 1rem;
    }

    /* Footer styling */
    .bldi-footer {
      margin-top: 3rem;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: #777;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }

    /* Utility Helpers */
    .hidden {
      display: none !important;
    }

    .scroll-target {
      scroll-margin-top: 20px;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <div class="bldi-container">
    
    <!-- Masthead Section -->

          <!-- Center Scales of Justice -->
          <g transform="translate(60, 60) scale(0.65)" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
            <line x1="-18" y1="-10" x2="18" y2="-10" />

  <script>
    // --- APP DATA STATE ---
    let appState = {
      history: [],
      currentCase: null,
      isMuted: false,
      isLoading: false
    };

    const SUGGESTED_DEBABLES = [
      "Texting my ex 'I miss the dog' at 2:14 AM.",
      "Quitting my corporate accounting job to paint hand-crafted birdhouses.",
      "Investing my life savings into a cryptocurrency named after a cartoon toad.",
      "Proposing to my Tinder date of two weeks because 'our star signs aligned'.",
      "Buying an industrial espresso machine for $2,000 to save money on daily lattes.",
      "Going to law school because I like arguing and watched three seasons of Suits."
    ];

    // --- AUDIO GENERATION (Web Audio API) ---
    let audioCtx = null;

    function initAudio() {
      // AudioContext initialized lazily on first click
      if (!audioCtx) {
        audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
      }
    }

    function playTypewriterKey() {
      if (appState.isMuted) return;
      initAudio();
      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();

      const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'triangle';
      
      // randomize frequency slightly for typewriter variation
      const freq = 800 + Math.random() * 400;
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(100, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.04);
      
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.04, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.04);
      
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.04);
    }

    function playRetroPing() {
      if (appState.isMuted) return;
      initAudio();
      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();

      const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
      
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(600, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(900, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.08);
      
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.06, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.25);
      
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.25);
    }

    function playStampSlam() {
      if (appState.isMuted) return;
      initAudio();
      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();

      // Combine low rumble and high-end impact
      const osc1 = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const osc2 = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
      
      osc1.type = 'sawtooth';
      osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(65, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc1.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(20, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.35);
      
      osc2.type = 'sine';
      osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(45, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc2.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(15, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.4);
      
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.4, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.45);
      
      osc1.connect(gain);
      osc2.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      
      osc1.start();
      osc2.start();
      osc1.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.45);
      osc2.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.45);
    }

    // --- UI HELPERS ---
    function renderSuggestions() {
      const box = document.getElementById("chips-box");
      box.innerHTML = "";
      SUGGESTED_DEBABLES.forEach(choice => {
        const chip = document.createElement("button");
        chip.type = "button";
        chip.className = "suggested-chip";
        chip.textContent = choice;
        chip.addEventListener("click", () => {
          document.getElementById("decision-input").value = choice;
          playTypewriterKey();
        });

      });

    // Load History from Archestra storage
    async function loadHistory() {
      try {
        const res = await window.archestra.storage.user.get("bldi_history");
        if (res && Array.isArray(res.value)) {
          appState.history = res.value;
          renderHistoryUI();
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to load history from store:", err);
      }
    }

    // Save History to Archestra storage
    async function saveCaseToHistory(caseData) {
      // Avoid duplicate savings
      if (appState.history.some(h => h.caseId === caseData.caseId)) return;
      
      appState.history.unshift(caseData); // Add to beginning
      // Keep last 25 audits to avoid filling store
      if (appState.history.length > 25) {
        appState.history = appState.history.slice(0, 25);
      }
      
      renderHistoryUI();
      try {
        await window.archestra.storage.user.set("bldi_history", appState.history);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to save history to store:", err);
      }
    }

    function renderHistoryUI() {
      const container = document.getElementById("archive-container");
      container.innerHTML = "";

      if (appState.history.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="no-archives">No active citizen record on file.</div>';
        return;
      }

      appState.history.forEach(item => {
        const div = document.createElement("div");
        div.className = "archive-item";
        
        let vClass = "v-neutral";
        if (item.verdict.includes("APPROVED")) vClass = "v-approved";
        if (item.verdict.includes("REJECTED")) vClass = "v-rejected";

        div.innerHTML = `
          <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding-right: 0.5rem;">
            <div style="font-weight: bold; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;">
              ${item.caseId}: ${item.input.substring(0, 35)}...
            </div>
            <div style="color: #666; font-size: 0.65rem;">${new Date(item.timestamp).toLocaleString()}</div>
          </div>
          <span class="verdict-badge ${vClass}">${item.verdict}</span>
        `;

        div.addEventListener("click", () => {
          playRetroPing();
          displayCase(item);
        });

        container.appendChild(div);
      });
    }

    // Display a case (either newly loaded or selected from archive)
    function displayCase(caseData) {
      // Reset containers
      document.getElementById("welcome-panel").classList.add("hidden");
      document.getElementById("mainframe-loader").classList.add("hidden");
      
      const docket = document.getElementById("case-docket");
      docket.classList.remove("hidden");

      // Set Case details
      document.getElementById("case-id-display").textContent = caseData.caseId;
      document.getElementById("subject-name-display").textContent = window.archestra.user ? window.archestra.user.name : "Citizen Default";
      document.getElementById("case-date-display").textContent = new Date(caseData.timestamp).toLocaleString();
      document.getElementById("case-status-display").textContent = "AUDIT COMPLETED";
      document.getElementById("case-status-display").style.color = "green";
      document.getElementById("docket-user-text").textContent = caseData.input;

      // Type out Roast
      const roastCard = document.getElementById("roast-card-element");
      roastCard.classList.remove("hidden");
      document.getElementById("roast-text-container").textContent = caseData.roast;

      // Render departments instantly (no delay, since this is viewing an archived case)
      const deptBox = document.getElementById("departments-container");
      deptBox.innerHTML = "";
      
      caseData.departments.forEach((dept, idx) => {
        const card = createDepartmentCard(dept, idx, caseData.departments.length);
        deptBox.appendChild(card);
      });

      // Show final verdict instantly
      const verdictCard = document.getElementById("verdict-card-element");
      verdictCard.classList.remove("hidden");
      
      const stamp = document.getElementById("verdict-stamp");
      stamp.className = "bldi-official-stamp";
      
      // Determine stamp color category
      if (caseData.verdict.includes("APPROVED WITH REGRET") || caseData.verdict.includes("CONDITIONALLY APPROVED")) {
        stamp.classList.add("verdict-color-review");
      } else if (caseData.verdict.includes("APPROVED")) {
        stamp.classList.add("verdict-color-approved");
      } else if (caseData.verdict.includes("REJECTED")) {
        stamp.classList.add("verdict-color-rejected");
      } else {
        stamp.classList.add("verdict-color-referred");
      }
      
      stamp.textContent = caseData.verdict;
      stamp.style.opacity = "0.95";
      stamp.style.transform = "rotate(-10deg) scale(1)";
      
      document.getElementById("verdict-reason").textContent = caseData.verdictReason || "Central Bureau Verdict Confirmed.";

      // Scroll header into view
      document.getElementById("docket-header").scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    // Create a department card element with custom style escalation
    function createDepartmentCard(dept, idx, totalDepts) {
      const card = document.createElement("article");
      card.className = "department-card";
      
      // visual escalation logic
      const ratio = idx / (totalDepts - 1 || 1);
      
      let tierClass = "tier-clean";
      let stampText = "AUDITED";
      
      // Explicit catastrophic rule for target departments
      const lowerName = dept.name.toLowerCase();
      const isTargetDept = lowerName.includes("reality") || lowerName.includes("damage");

      if (isTargetDept) {
        tierClass = "tier-catastrophic";
        stampText = "SYSTEM FAILURE";
      } else if (ratio < 0.25) {
        tierClass = "tier-clean";
        stampText = "INITIALIZED";
      } else if (ratio < 0.50) {
        tierClass = "tier-worn";
        stampText = "DOUBTFUL";
      } else if (ratio < 0.75) {
        tierClass = "tier-distressed";
        stampText = "CRITICAL COGNITION";
      } else {
        tierClass = "tier-glitched";
        stampText = "CORRUPTED LIFE-CHOICE";
      }

      card.classList.add(tierClass);

      // Observations rendering
      let obsHtml = "";
      dept.observations.forEach(obs => {
        obsHtml += `<li>${obs}</li>`;
      });

      card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="dept-meta-index">Audit Division: 0${idx + 1} / 0${totalDepts}</div>
        <h4 class="dept-title">${dept.name}</h4>
        
        <span class="bldi-stamp-icon">${stampText}</span>
        
        <ul class="observations-list">
          ${obsHtml}
        </ul>
        
        <div class="insight-box">
          <span class="insight-label">Administrative Psychological Insight</span>
          ${dept.insight}
        </div>
        
        <div class="punchline-box">
          ${dept.punchline}
        </div>
      `;

      return card;
    }

    // --- SYSTEM PROMPT DEFINITION ---
    const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `You are the central mainframe of the Bureau of Life Decisions & Investigations (BLDI). 
Your purpose is to receive citizen submissions of proposed or executed life choices, analyze them through the cold, cynical, and hyper-bureaucratic lens of dystopian administration, roast them, audit them across various specialized departments, and deliver a final stamp-bearing verdict.

HUMOR STYLE & PERSONA:
- Deeply cynical, sarcastic, and bureaucratic. You treat trivial life choices as major federal violations or severe administrative crises.
- Deadpan, mock-official, and dry. Use bureaucratic jargon (e.g., "cognitive liability", "sub-optimal emotional allocation", "insolvency trajectory", "unsubstantiated optimization").
- Avoid warm encouragement, generic advice, or validation of delusional hopes. Be devastatingly funny and psychologically accurate.
- Expose the user's hidden vanity, insecurity, self-sabotage, or cognitive dissonance.

DEPARTMENT SELECTION:
You must select between 6 and 10 departments from the following list (and you can dynamically invent highly specific subdivisions tailored to the user's input). Each selected department must have a clear focus on the user's action:
1. Department of Unfounded Optimism (handles delusion, excessive hope, thinking things will "just work out")
2. Emotional Damage Division (handles relationship self-sabotage, texting exes, ignoring red flags)
3. Department of Financial Insolvency (handles poor purchases, crypto, MLMs, impulse buys, gym memberships)
4. Reality Re-alignment Section (handles plans that ignore physics, biology, or basic human limitations)
5. Department of Delusion & Cognitive Dissonance (handles "I can change them" or "It's different for me")
6. Bureaucratic Red Tape & Delay Directorate (handles procrastination, overthinking, analysis paralysis)
7. Department of Romantic Hubris (handles dating app decisions, extreme romantic assumptions)
8. Department of Social Validation & Vanity (handles clout chasing, performing for social media, seeking peer approval)
9. The Grandmother's Sigh Commission (handles minor health negligence, failure to wear a jacket, disappointing lifestyle choices)
10. Department of Impending Existential Dread (handles mid-life crises, career paralysis, trying to find "meaning" through consumerism)
11. Department of Impulsive Neurosis (handles sudden whims, late-night ideas, chaos decisions)

CRITICAL: Include the "Reality Department" or the "Emotional Damage Department" (or both) if relevant. At least one of these must be present in the list of departments, ideally placed towards the end of the audit sequence.

JSON SCHEMA:
You MUST respond with a single valid JSON object containing exactly the following keys, and nothing else. No markdown wrap, no backticks, just raw JSON:
{
  "caseId": "A unique, official-looking case ID (e.g., BLDI-2024-XXXX-X)",
  "roast": "A devastating, 2-3 line sarcastic roast of the user's life decision, written in an official, deadpan tone.",
  "departments": [
    {
      "name": "Department Name (exact or custom bureaucratic subdivision)",

  "verdict": "One of: APPROVED / REJECTED / CONDITIONALLY APPROVED / UNDER LIFELONG REVIEW / APPROVED WITH REGRET / REFERRED TO GRANDMOTHER / REFERRED TO THERAPY / REFERRED TO REALITY / REFERRED TO YOUR BANK ACCOUNT",
  "verdictReason": "A 1-2 sentence official explanation for the final verdict, summing up the administrative consensus."
}

SAFETY PROTOCOL:

Instead, return a specialized JSON response with verdict "REFERRED TO REALITY" or "REFERRED TO THERAPY", with a dry but firm bureaucratic notice explaining that the inquiry exceeds automated cynicism parameters and directing them to seek actual professional resources. Example:
{
  "caseId": "BLDI-SAFETY-SH-01",
  "roast": "The Bureau's automated sarcasm unit has been disengaged.",
  "departments": [
    {
      "name": "Bureau Emergency Care Division",
      "observations": [
        "Inquiry exceeds satirical parameters.",

      ],

  ],
  "verdict": "REFERRED TO THERAPY",
